description: Expand the API route error handling to also catch the missing RIOT_API_KEY scenario (status 500 with message containing 'RIOT_API_KEY') and return the same user-friendly HTTP 503 response. This ensures all key-related failures (401 from Riot, 403 from Riot, and 500 from missing key) are handled uniformly.
steps: In app/api/riot/route.ts, expand the existing if condition in the catch block from `if (error.status === 401 || error.status === 403)` to also include the case where the API key is missing. The condition should be: `if (error.status === 401 || error.status === 403 || (error.status === 500 && error.message.includes('RIOT_API_KEY')))`. This matches the pattern used by multiple prior PRs (e.g. #22-#27) that were never merged.
Run npm run lint to verify zero lint errors.
Run npm run build to verify successful compilation.
acceptance_criteria: The catch block in app/api/riot/route.ts returns HTTP 503 with 'Service temporarily unavailable, please try again later' for RiotApiError with status 500 and message containing 'RIOT_API_KEY'
npm run lint passes with zero errors
npm run build passes with zero errors
findings: Fix applied successfully. npm run lint and npm run build both pass. Branch: fix/riot-api-key-missing-handling. Commit: 5008ffb.
